// diagnostic E0112

Jet.ValueTypeMismatch

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

What

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

Why

Jet checks each use so a call cannot receive or render the wrong type

Fix

Use a value of the expected type, or convert it before passing or interpolating it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ValueTypeMismatch: Tests/UI/alias_names_its_target_by_home.stderr.

Error: Jet.ValueTypeMismatch: `spot_x` wants `geo.Point` for argument 1, but this is Int (a whole number)
  --> Tests/UI/alias_names_its_target_by_home.jet:16:18
    |
 16 |     print(spot_x(7))
    |                  ^
 Why: Every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: Use `geo.Point` here
